description: ADD_MONTHS preserves end-of-month (Snowflake): when the input is the last day of its month the result is the last day of the target month, so ADD_MONTHS('2016-02-29', 1) is 2016-03-31 rather than the plain 2016-03-29, and the rule holds for negative offsets too. A non-month-end date is shifted normally. The result TYPE follows the input (live-verified): a VARCHAR input is implicitly cast to TIMESTAMP_NTZ - its rendered text carries a time-of-day - while a DATE input stays DATE and renders as a bare date. Converted 1:1 from functions/AddMonthsTest (now retired); the Java class asserted LocalDateTime vs LocalDate objects, a distinction the converted suite keeps by reading TO_VARCHAR of the result.
